audio.text: Shouldn't we have heard back about the grant by now?

options: I heard the band play in the park last night.
Yes, we should go back to the library.
The grant was for three thousand dollars.
They said decisions could take another couple of weeks.

why.en: Negative question expressing worry → an explanation for the delay. A repeats "heard" literally; B repeats "should" and "back" in a different sense.
why.tr: Endişe bildiren olumsuz soru → gecikmeye bir açıklama. A "heard" kelimesini gerçek anlamıyla tekrar ediyor; B "should" ve "back" kelimelerini başka anlamda tekrar ediyor.
why.es: Pregunta negativa que expresa preocupación → una explicación del retraso. A repite "heard" en sentido literal; B repite "should" y "back" con otro sentido.
